mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role IS NOT NULL) AS totalSysUser,# 系统用户数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role = 'owner') AS totalCustomers,# 客户人数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role = 'veterinarian') AS totalVeterinarian,# 兽医人数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role = 'foster_staff') AS totalFosterStaff,# 寄养员工人数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role IN ('veterinarian', 'foster_staff')) AS totalStaff,# 员工人数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order) AS totalOrder,# 订单数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'MEDICAL') AS totalMedicalOrders,# 医疗订单数 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'FOSTER') AS totalFosterOrders,# 寄养订单数 (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM service_order) AS totalIncome,# 收入 (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'MEDICAL') AS totalMedicalIncome,# 医疗收入 (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM service_order WHERE service_type = 'FOSTER') AS totalFosterIncome# 寄养收入
